scope: G17; component audit and isolated descriptive replay of existing PFL functions. No imports or changes in canonical Regime V2.
important_namespace_distinction: No fragilityScore exists in the inspected PFL engine; that field found in V1 shadow evidence is a different regime implementation. No score is read or imported here.

local_data.source: Portfolio Fragility Lab bundled demonstration dataset
local_data.calendar: Weekdays generated by code; includes exchange holidays; synthetic only.

current_api_temporal_contract.assessment: PFL row dates and free-text provenance cannot prove PIT availability. Reuse of arithmetic does not transfer temporal eligibility; an explicit R2 context is attached by this offline harness only.

offline_experiment.scope: Same-price-family diagnostic; no canonical integration, new core family, prediction or OOS claim.
offline_experiment.price_basis: Actual Yahoo native adjclose from preserved P8 bytes, with no quote.close fallback.
offline_experiment.calendar: Same SPY observed-session R2 proxy, no future rows or interior date deletion.
offline_experiment.methodology_note: PFL functions retain their original constants. Equal weights are an explicit hypothetical portfolio for compatibility, not observed market holdings.

changes.note: Different frequency or labels is not evidence that one is superior. Clusters use an up-to-252-return matrix; canonical C uses 21/63-return correlation features.

components.semantic_compatibility: Portfolio allocation property, not market regime evidence.
components.data_compatibility: Requires dated holdings/weights. Equal sector weights in this study are explicitly hypothetical.
components.dependency: Exogenous user portfolio input; no contemporaneous holdings history exists.
components.incrementality: USEFUL_FOR_PORTFOLIO_ONLY; zero time variation under frozen equal weights.
components.maintenance: LOW inside PFL; HIGH if a new market-wide holdings source is added.

components.semantic_compatibility: Equity co-movement is compatible as a diagnostic; not a second family vote.
components.data_compatibility: Same native Yahoo adjusted close inputs can be converted explicitly to the PFL total-return index convention; captured late, R2 only.
components.dependency: Same eleven sector ETF price lineage as C03 equity/fragility. Window 60-252 returns versus canonical 21/63.
components.incrementality: INDETERMINATE_VALUE; repeated price transform, not new independent observations.
components.maintenance: MEDIUM: window, aligned calendar, price basis, source capture and low-sample handling.

components.semantic_compatibility: Topology/dispersion of correlation can describe concentration lost by a simple mean.
components.data_compatibility: At least three positive holdings, 60 common returns; unchanged complete-link threshold 0.7.
components.dependency: Exact same sector returns; additional structure within the equity family only.
components.maintenance: MEDIUM-HIGH: adds portfolio weights, clustering threshold, window and topology-specific failure explanations.

components.semantic_compatibility: Portfolio risk decomposition is useful to an owner of the stated holdings, but depends on the chosen weights.
components.data_compatibility: Requires a consistent total-return basis, currency and aligned sample covariance; zero-volatility inputs remain unavailable.
components.dependency: Same price covariance; no new independent family. Hypothetical allocation cannot be called market-wide fragility.
components.incrementality: INDETERMINATE_CORE_VALUE; useful within-portfolio decomposition, not a canonical feature proposal.
components.maintenance: MEDIUM: weights and negative marginal contributions require their own product semantics.

components.semantic_compatibility: Trailing realized portfolio path; retrospective recovery dates must not leak past the as-of date.
components.data_compatibility: Same total-return input and explicit initial weights; buy-and-hold share path differs from a rebalanced allocation.
components.dependency: Derived from equity prices already present. Cross-asset portfolios depend on new qualified source history.
components.incrementality: CONTEXTUAL_ONLY; no evidence for an independent core family.
components.maintenance: MEDIUM: window censoring, recovery and portfolio path conventions.

components.semantic_compatibility: User-selected hypothetical assumptions, not observed economic evidence.
components.data_compatibility: Direct shock scenarios use user inputs; covariance scenarios additionally use historical covariance.
components.dependency: No new observation. A shock assumption or lambda cannot become measured regime evidence.
components.incrementality: REJECT_AS_CORE_EVIDENCE; useful only as a scenario tool.
components.maintenance: Keep isolated in PFL; would introduce arbitrary scenario thresholds if promoted.

components.semantic_compatibility: Retrospective scenario context for explicit portfolios; named episodes are not daily PIT labels.
components.data_compatibility: Bundled observations are synthetic. Real user CSV needs complete coverage, currency, total-return and inception proofs.
components.dependency: Static episode definitions plus price paths; no independent current observation.
components.incrementality: INDETERMINATE for real data; synthetic outputs cannot validate regime quality.
components.maintenance: HIGH if promoted: historical raw data, vintages, proxy governance, episode censoring.

incremental_evidence_conclusion: Cluster topology and weighted covariance summaries expose information beyond a single mean correlation numerically, but all are deterministic transforms of the existing equity lineage. No independent source, observed portfolio weights, or superiority evidence is added. Longer persistence reflects a longer window and cannot alone justify promotion.
decision: Keep PFL as its own portfolio tool. Park any market-wide clustering extension for a specifically justified within-equity diagnostic; no core proposal.

complexity_of_proposed_promotion.new_data_source: NO for sector-only transform; YES for real holdings or new assets
complexity_of_proposed_promotion.new_runtime_dependency: Would couple to PFL code if integrated; none added
complexity_of_proposed_promotion.new_rule: Weighting plus clustering interpretation would require a separately authorized contract
complexity_of_proposed_promotion.new_threshold: 0.7 and 60/252 windows are existing PFL constants, not approved V2 thresholds
complexity_of_proposed_promotion.new_failure_mode: Weights, total-return compatibility, low sample, clustering discontinuities, missing temporal envelope
